Professional biography
↗

What enables people to move from knowing what is possible to actually doing something worthwhile?

The Spotted Ape is the independent strategic practice of Marcel Maré, a behavioural designer, researcher and strategic consultant working across design, human behaviour and emerging technology.

His work has ranged from understanding why households adopt new energy technologies to helping organisations navigate strategic choices and technological change.
